imp.title: Imports
imp.description: Bring records in from a spreadsheet: download the template, fill it in, upload it, check every problem row, then commit.
imp.denied: You do not have permission to use the import centre.
imp.loadError: The imports could not be loaded.
imp.error.generic: The request could not be completed. Try again, or contact your administrator.
imp.types.empty.body: No import types are available for your licence or permissions.
imp.readOnly.body: The licence is read-only or locked, so new imports cannot start. Earlier batches can still be viewed.
imp.type.denied.body: Your role does not allow importing this type. Ask an administrator for the permission.
imp.template.help: The template says which file columns fill which fields.
imp.templates.empty.body: Ask a template designer to create one.
imp.mode.create.explain: Every row creates a new record. A row whose key already exists is reported as a problem.
imp.mode.update.explain: A row whose key already exists updates that record; other rows create new ones. A batch with updates cannot be rolled back.
imp.file.help: CSV (comma or semicolon) or Excel (.xlsx). The file is scanned before it is read.
imp.uploaded: The file was uploaded. Check it before anything is saved.
imp.batches.empty.body: Uploaded files appear here with their progress.
imp.batch.notFound.body: This import does not exist or you may not see it.
imp.progress.label: Progress of the import
imp.validated.good.body: {count} rows passed every check. Nothing has been saved yet.
imp.validated.bad.body: Download the error file, fix those rows in your spreadsheet and upload it again. Rows with problems are never saved.
imp.failed.body: The import stopped. Check the problems below or ask your administrator for the job log.
imp.commit.blocked: Fix the problems and upload the file again before saving.
imp.rollback.title: Roll back this import?
imp.rollback.effect: The {count} records this import created will be removed. This works only while none of them has changed.
imp.rollback.possible: You can roll this import back while none of its records has changed.
imp.rollback.unavailable: This import can no longer be rolled back.
imp.refused.title: That did not work
imp.refused.infected: The file was refused because the virus scan found a problem in it.
imp.refused.tooLarge: The file is too large. Split it into smaller files.
imp.refused.tooManyRows: The file has too many rows. Split it into smaller files.
imp.refused.unsupported: This kind of file cannot be imported. Use CSV or Excel (.xlsx).
imp.refused.rollbackChanged: This import cannot be rolled back because some of its records have changed since.
imp.refused.rollbackExpired: This import cannot be rolled back because the rollback period is over.
imp.refused.rollbackUpdated: This import cannot be rolled back because it updated existing records.
imp.refused.rollbackNotCommitted: Only a saved import can be rolled back.
imp.refused.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
imp.errors.title: Problems found
imp.errors.first: The first {count} problems are shown here. The error file has them all.
imp.designer.title: Import templates
imp.designer.description: Choose which file column fills each field, how values are cleaned, and test with a sample file. A change makes a new version.
imp.designer.denied: You do not have permission to design import templates.
imp.designer.updated: The template was saved as a new version.
imp.designer.failed: The template could not be saved
imp.designer.mapping.help: For each field, type the column heading used in your file. A default fills the field when the cell is empty.
imp.designer.missing: {count} required fields have neither a file column nor a default.
imp.template.name: Template
imp.template.code.help: A short code that stays the same, for example users_standard.
imp.template.delimiter.help: Automatic works for comma and semicolon files.
imp.column.default.help: Used when the cell is empty.
imp.column.culture.help: The language whose number style the file uses, for example en-US.
imp.test.title: Test with a sample file
imp.test.help: The file is checked with this template. Nothing is stored or saved.
imp.test.saveFirst: Save the template first, then test it with a sample file.
imp.test.sample: First rows as they would be imported
imp.refused.rollbackInUse: This import cannot be rolled back because other records now depend on what it created.
imp.refused.rollbackForbidden: You may not roll back this import: removing what it created needs a permission you do not hold.
